# Train feedback of `flex_methanol.wsp` D2

D2 on the train partition its laws were written from (in-sample). Bracketed CRPS values, in order: D1, the D²-law baseline, `flex.wsp` W2, W1, W0, then the fitted baselines.

Columns: conditions and D0 (mm); the model's laws for the run (`Dcr` critical diameter in mm, `piR`
prior probability of the radiative class, `De_d` diffusive extinction diameter in mm, `tR` radiative
extinction time in s, `pc` cool-flame probability, `Kc` cool rate in mm²/s, `Dce` cool-flame extinction
diameter in mm); NASA's `k` and `Dext` from the test sheet; `knee` and `dk`: time and diameter where the
train series stops shrinking; CRPS in µm at cutoffs 1, 3 and 5 s (other releases of the file in
brackets); the state probabilities hot/cool/no flame at each cutoff; the signed error of the median
5–10 s after each cutoff in µm (prediction minus observation; `*` marks 2–5 s where nothing later
exists); the late rate ratio at the 3 s cutoff and the number of prefix values the validity gate
dropped. Worst runs first. Train partition only.
